text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm Bamboo Memory, head of the Tracen 
Academy Disciplinary Committee!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, the thrilling journey 
toward my debut begins! Just thinking 
about it gets me so hyped I can't sit 
still! Because—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Because I've got a burning "dream"— to 
have the greatest legendary showdowns with 
the greatest rivals!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To make the dream I've had since I was 
little come true, I'm gonna give it 
everything I've got with full-throttle 
hot-blooded passion!
